lines.zh: 我从地缝里伸出去，越伸越长。
lines.en: I reach out of the crack. Longer and longer.
I don't walk. I probe.

lines.zh: 一节一节地推过去，很慢。
lines.en: Segment by segment, slowly.
I creep along the floor. Looking for ankles.

lines.zh: 这一根往前，另外几根等着。
lines.en: One reaches. Others wait.
I go around the rocks. No noise.

lines.zh: 下界的岩壁太薄，我一顶就破。
lines.en: Nether rock is thin. One push and it splits.

lines.zh: 我这样挪，是为了把路封住。
lines.en: I move to close the path.
My tip searches the air.
I tighten, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你走过的地面，我都跟过。
lines.en: The floor you cross. I've followed it.

lines.zh: 我伸过去，你退了，我又伸。
lines.en: I reach. You retreat. I reach again.

lines.zh: 我挂在洞顶，像一根绳子。
lines.en: I hang from the ceiling like a rope.
My surface is wet. It drips.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等你以为安全。
lines.en: I stay still until you feel safe.

lines.zh: 这根触手比我本人更耐心。
lines.en: This tentacle is more patient than the rest of me.
My tip twitches, faintly.
Coiled in the rock crevice.
I draw the ground's heat in.

lines.zh: 这里没有风，我的摆动是自己。
lines.en: No wind here. The swaying is mine.
Counting footsteps on the floor.

lines.zh: 我缩回去一点，再伸出来。
lines.en: I pull back a little, then extend.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，但我在看你。
lines.en: No eyes. I'm still watching you.

lines.zh: 从下界岩缝里，我探出一截。
lines.en: I reach one length out of a netherrack crack.

lines.zh: 我的尖端朝你抬起来了。
lines.en: My tip has lifted toward you.
Counting how many of me there are?

lines.zh: 我看你的方式，是感觉震动。
lines.en: I see you by vibration.
You stepped on my shadow.

lines.zh: 你再站一会儿，我就够到了。
lines.en: Stand a while longer and I'll reach you.
Your shadow moves quickly.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，很轻。
lines.en: I know your footsteps. Light ones.
I circle your feet. Slowly.
I pulled back. I'll reach again.
You took a segment off.
Slime everywhere.
It hurts. Not that kind of hurt.
Out again.
Fast blade. Noted.

lines.zh: 我这一段已经不能用了。
lines.en: This segment is spent.
I coil half a turn away.
More of me in the seams. Don't rush.
You can hit me. Can't finish me.
Flesh. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 你把手伸过来，我很愿意。
lines.en: Offer your hand. I'd like that.
Good heat coming off that.

lines.zh: 不用举那么高，我够不到。
lines.en: No need to raise it. Out of reach.
I don't eat that. I eat you.
Set it down. I'll come at once.
My tip is dripping. Don't waste it.

lines.zh: 你过来一步，我就少伸一尺。
lines.en: One step from you saves me a foot of reach.
This smells wrong. Iron.

lines.zh: 你拿食物喂一根触手，真怪。
lines.en: Feeding a tentacle. Strange.
You stepped on this tentacle.

lines.zh: 我被压了一下，又弹回来。
lines.en: Pressed down. I spring back.
Step around. This one's hard.
Something's wrapped your leg. That's me.
The impact tells me where you are.
I pull back and try another angle.

lines.zh: 别用刀砍，砍一节长两节。
lines.en: Don't cut. Cut one and two grow.
You kick me away. I'm back.

lines.zh: 我压在你的鞋面上，很沉。
lines.en: I weigh on your boot. Heavy.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我的黏液留你身上了。
lines.en: That touch left slime on you.
This part of me has no sex.

lines.zh: 你想要的是另一根，不是这根。
lines.en: You want a different part of me.
Don't touch my tip. It reacts.

lines.zh: 我只是一个器官，不配对。
lines.en: I'm an organ, not a mate.

lines.zh: 缠住你和抱住你，是一回事。
lines.en: Coiling and embracing. Same thing.

lines.zh: 我从地底下伸出来，不为这个。
lines.en: I reach up for other reasons.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，黏液不好洗。
lines.en: Step back. The slime stains.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的体温就兴奋，不是爱。
lines.en: Your body heat excites me. Not love.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在很深的地方。
lines.en: My mate is somewhere deep.
This tentacle only grabs.
I coil around it. Easy.

lines.zh: 东西在地上，我一卷就拿走。
lines.en: It's on the floor. One coil takes it.

lines.zh: 我举到半空，看看是什么。
lines.en: I lift it and look.
This can't cut me.
Stuck to me. Won't come off.

lines.zh: 我压碎了一块，声音很脆。
lines.en: I crushed one. A crisp sound.
Yours. I caught it.
Iron smell on the floor. I hate it.

lines.zh: 我把它递给别的手，不是我。
lines.en: I hand it to my other limbs. Not mine.
Coiled too tight. It broke.
The floor shook. You.
I've caught your shadow.
Too narrow here. No dodging.
My tip bends toward you.

lines.zh: 我从熔岩里伸出来，绕住你。
lines.en: I reach out of the lava and coil around you.
I feel heat. Close.

lines.zh: 你退，我不追，我等你回来。
lines.en: You retreat. I don't follow. I wait.

lines.zh: 这面墙后面，全是我的兄弟。
lines.en: Behind this wall. All my kin.

lines.zh: 你听见滴水声吗？那是我。
lines.en: Hear the dripping? That's me.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我第一次就记住了。
lines.en: I remembered your spot the first time.
One squeeze and you're stuck.
Your torchlight is shaking.
Don't go deeper. More of me there.
I've stretched. Now I reach.

lines.zh: 我慢慢缠过去，一圈一圈。
lines.en: I coil toward you, loop by loop.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就多伸一节。
lines.en: One step back and I gain a segment.

lines.zh: 我的黏液在地面留了痕。
lines.en: My slime leaves a trail.
Cut one and three remain.
Waiting for your foot to land.
More of me in the rock seams.

lines.zh: 下界的触手，从地缝里出来。
lines.en: A nether tentacle comes from the cracks.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声让我确定了位置。
lines.en: Your breathing fixes your position.

lines.zh: 这一片地面，都是我的范围。
lines.en: This whole floor is my range.

lines.zh: 我再伸一点，就到你的脚踝。
lines.en: A little further and I reach your ankle.

lines.zh: 你踢不干净的，我太多了。
lines.en: You can't kick it all away. Too many of me.

lines.zh: 地面上有湿的痕迹，看见了？
lines.en: Wet marks on the floor. See them?

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，你没注意头顶。
lines.en: I come from above. You never checked the ceiling.

lines.zh: 你退到岩浆边上，我停了一下。
lines.en: You backed to the lava. I paused.

lines.zh: 我的圈越收越紧，你听得见。
lines.en: The loop is tightening. You can hear it.

lines.zh: 这一片墙缝里全是湿的。
lines.en: Every seam in this wall is wet.
I've got you. Tightening.
You're dragged down.
My tip lashes your face.
That left slime, not a bruise.
I drag you toward the crack.
You cut. I coil tighter.

lines.zh: 触手卷住脚踝，往岩壁上拖。
lines.en: My tentacle wraps your ankle and drags you to the wall.
One yank and you're down.

lines.zh: 这东西没有骨头，压不碎。
lines.en: No bones in me. Can't be crushed.
Your ankle is inside my loop.

lines.zh: 我把你举起来，往墙上撞。
lines.en: I lift you and swing you at the wall.

lines.zh: 你挣脱了一次，还有第二次。
lines.en: You broke free once. There's a second time.

lines.zh: 我的尖端在你脖子的位置。
lines.en: My tip is at your throat.

lines.zh: 你不是第一个被缠住的。
lines.en: You're not the first to be caught.
Something wet against your face.
I let go. You hit the floor.

lines.zh: 我从下界的地缝里钻出来。
lines.en: I come up through a Nether fissure.

lines.zh: 岩壁上鼓起一块，然后破了。
lines.en: The wall bulges, then splits.
One drops from the ceiling. Me.

lines.zh: 地面先湿，然后我伸出来。
lines.en: The floor dampens, then I emerge.
The brick under your feet shifted.
I climb out by the lava.

lines.zh: 这里有一条缝，正好够我。
lines.en: A seam here. Wide enough for me.
The tip first. Then all of me.
I waited a long time inside the wall.
Nether rock was always soft.
My slime seeps out first.

lines.zh: 你听见石头裂的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear the stone split?

lines.zh: 火烧过来，我的表面收缩。
lines.en: Fire. My surface shrinks.
I fall from the ceiling. Heavy.

lines.zh: 水把我泡软了，我使不上劲。
lines.en: Water softens me. No strength left.

lines.zh: 炸得我这根断成了两截。
lines.en: The blast cut me into two pieces.
Something's stuck inside me.

lines.zh: 这力量我不懂，全身一抽。
lines.en: I don't know that power. Everything spasms.

lines.zh: 太久没抓到东西，我干瘪了。
lines.en: Too long without a catch. I'm drying up.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的黏液走遍全身。
lines.en: Lightning runs the length of my slime.
Falling, still reaching.
